prompt: `mypy` (strict mode, configured in `pyproject.toml`) reports errors in `src/`. Fix them so that `mypy` passes, without `# type: ignore`, `cast`, `Any`, or changes to the mypy configuration.
bash_commands: cat pyproject.toml; find src -name '*.py' | xargs wc -l; mypy 2>&1 | tail -40
cat src/trailhead/geo.py src/trailhead/report.py; grep -rn "heading\|initial_bearing\|compass" src tests | grep -v "^src/trailhead/report.py"
cat tests/test_report.py; grep -rni "loop\|heading" README* docs 2>/dev/null; git log --oneline | head

set -e
sed -i 's/^def initial_bearing(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):/def initial_bearing(lat1: float, lon1: float, lat2: float, lon2: float) -> float:/' src/trailhead/geo.py
python - <<'EOF'
p='src/trailhead/report.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('def _heading(track: Track) -> str | None:','def _heading(track: Track) -> str:')
s=s.replace('        return None\n','        return "loop"\n')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
git diff --stat; mypy; ruff check src 2>/dev/null || true; python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3

grep -n "def make_track" -A12 tests/conftest.py; cd tests && python -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'../src')
from conftest import *
" 2>&1 | tail -2

cd .. && PYTHONPATH=src python -c "
from trailhead.track import Track, Point
from trailhead.report import summarise, format_summary
print(format_summary(summarise(Track('Loop',[Point(0,0,100),Point(0.01,0.01,150),Point(0,0.0001,100)]))))"
